title: Design n Decor: Beam Fix
description: Fixes Beam rendering issues in Create: Design n Decor where adjacent block faces incorrectly become transparent.
body:
Design n Decor Beam Fix is a lightweight compatibility mod for NeoForge 1.21.1 that fixes rendering issues with the Beam block from Create: Design n Decor.

The issue can cause adjacent full blocks to incorrectly render transparent faces when placed against beams. This mod applies a client-side rendering fix that prevents improper face culling and restores normal block rendering behavior.

Features:

- Fixes transparent neighboring block faces around Beam blocks
- Client-side rendering correction
- Lightweight with no gameplay changes
- Drop-in compatibility mod
- No world conversion required
